PreceptDef.label: discomfort preferred
PreceptDef.description: Comfort is a weakness. We prefer hardship and discomfort, as they remind us that we are strong enough to endure them.

li.label: uncomfortable
li.description: I've been pleasantly uncomfortable recently. This hardship reminds me that I am strong enough to endure it.

li.label: comfortable
li.description: I've been too comfortable recently. I need some hardship in my life.

li.label: quite comfortable
li.description: I've been far too comfortable recently. All this luxury is making me soft.

li.label: extremely comfortable
li.description: I've been living in disgusting luxury. I need to experience some real discomfort.

li.label: luxuriantly comfortable
li.description: This is unbearable. I am surrounded by softness and comfort, and I can feel myself becoming weak.
